title: Glass Hours
prompt: dance pop in the style of the band big sis
description: A glossy, dreamy dance-pop song that opens on felt piano chords and sidechained pads, hits a bright plucky chorus early, then deconstructs into chopped-vocal fragments and stripped piano before lifting one last time. Euphoric and a little bittersweet, built on a four-chord progression with shimmering arps.
